name: @morra/platform-web
description: Browser platform layer: single AudioContext ownership + clock mapping, camera/mic device access, web implementations of @morra/core's ports (localStorage PlayerModelStore, batched-NDJSON TelemetrySink, PerformanceClock, CryptoRandomSource), and a minimal asset manager (clip sets, Cache-Storage-backed model fetch). Extracted from spikes/s03-beat.html's proven ClockMap/event-bus/playermodel-storage/rival-clip-loading patterns; spikes/** stays untouched.
